notes.title: New update for VR-X Player Steam Edition!
notes.content:
[h1]Important changes in version 1.1.2046 compared to version 1.0.728[/h1]

[h1]New Features and improvements in this update[/h1]
[list]  
    [*] Settings: Choose you control device (VR/Mouse/Controller)
    [*] Improved support of 3D media
    [*] New overview while navigating through virtual tours
    [*] New transitions between virtual spaces in virtual tours
    [*] Several small improvements and bugfixes
[/list]
